desc:
A specially made toy that has recently become wildly popular at Aurelia Academy. Strike it, and it rings out with a sharp clang; flick it, and it answers with a lively thunk-thud. A closer look at the little drum reveals rough scratches, strange doodles, and even... wait, are those bite marks?! "Thunk! Thud! Thunk! Thud! All units, move out——!!!"
—A familiar shout often echoing through the academy hallways between classes.
desc2: Equip to increase Anomaly Agents' combat capabilities
desc3: Pick it up and play another thunk-thud concerto!
name: Boisterous Echoes
